title: Rav Sama son of Rav Assi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 33b, raising an objection to Rav Ashi. Hyman describes his father Rav Assi as Rav Ashi’s contemporary, as explained in his entry, and Rav Sama himself, the son, as Rav Ashi’s student.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “The son” in Hyman’s final clause refers to Rav Sama, son of Rav Assi, not to another generation descended from Rav Sama. The William Davidson Ketubot 33b paragraph has Rav Sama son of Rav Assi addressing Rav Ashi, with an alternative Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi; the chronology and student claim remain Hyman’s.

The saved Ketubot 33b paragraph names Rav Sama son of Rav Assi and alternatively Rav Sama son of Rav Ashi. Hyman’s statements about father and son, contemporaneity and discipleship remain his interpretation.
